title: echinochloa crus-galli subsp. oryzicola
intro: Echinochloa crus-galli subsp. oryzicola, commonly known as barnyard grass, is a type of invasive grass that belongs to the family Poaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in various cultures for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation, relieving digestive issues, and promoting wound healing. The health benefits associated with barnyard grass include antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory activities, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids. The therapeutic actions of barnyard grass include anti-cancer, anti-diabetic, and anti-hypertensive effects, making it a valuable resource in traditional medicine.
